# Improving the lives of the people we touch

Convatec is a global medical products and technologies company focused on therapies for the
management of chronic conditions, leading in advanced wound care, stoma care, continence and
critical care, and infusion devices.
[ Learn about us ][223]

## Forever Caring

Living with a condition, no matter how long or short it may be, is a journey. One that will be
different for everyone. That can feel unpredictable and unfair. And at times even life changing. But
we believe it never needs to be YOU changing. That you deserve better, holistic care. So, you can
keep being you.



[Stoma Care] ;

### Stoma Care

Information, support and advice on post operative lifestyle for ileostomy, urostomy, colostomy and
general stoma care patients.
[Read more][224] [Advanced Wound Care] ;

### Advanced Wound Care

Leading the way in advanced wound and skin care innovation. Learn more about all our high quality
products to help heal wounds faster.
[Read more][225]




## Healthy Bonds. Our bonds determine who we are.

;

There’s no bond more important than the one with your own body. Convatec helps you create a healthy
bond with yourself, your stoma. And then, with the world around you.

Start creating a healthy bond with your stoma by finding the answers you need quickly with me+
Answers.

The me+™ programme offers you the right support so you feel stronger, more confident and ready for
what’s ahead. The ostomy products and support you need, tips and advice for stoma care, and a
community you can grow with. Have questions about living with an stoma? Our me+ specialists and
stoma nurses are waiting to help you, call 18002674989 or write to us at
customerserviceindia@convatec.com

[ Join me+ today ][226]

## Feature Highlight: AWC, CC, + Flexi-Seal

Hydrofiber® Technology

### Our Hydrofiber® Technology

**Hydrofiber^{®} Technology is a soft, absorbent material that transforms into a gel on contact with
wound fluid.**

For more than 25 years, Convatec has been helping clinicians to improve patient outcomes, enabling
patients to move on with their lives through the use of Hydrofiber^{®} Technology – globally proven
and trusted. Discover how the unique, innovative Hydrofiber^{®} Technology can help you make a real
impact on the lives of people living with a wound.

Our Hydrofiber® Technology Learn more

[ Learn more ][227] [three doctors] ; Flexi-Seal™

### Flexi-Seal™ FMS

Flexi-Seal™ Fecal Management System (FMS) is an indwelling fecal management catheter intended for
use to manage fecal incontinence through the collection of liquid to semi-liquid stool and to
provide access to administer medications.

Flexi-Seal™ FMS Learn more

[ Learn more ][228] [Flexi-Seal™ FMS] ;

## Sign up and be the first to know about our exciting innovations.

Learning how to live fully with a condition takes education, resources and support. And with me+, we
make sure you don’t have to figure it out alone. Getting the benefits of me+ is easy. Join today for
complete support.

# Improving the lives of the people we touch

Convatec is a global medical products and technologies company focused on therapies for the
management of chronic conditions, leading in advanced wound care, stoma care, continence and
critical care, and infusion devices.
[ Learn about us ][223]

## Forever Caring

Living with a condition, no matter how long or short it may be, is a journey. One that will be
different for everyone. That can feel unpredictable and unfair. And at times even life changing. But
we believe it never needs to be YOU changing. That you deserve better, holistic care. So, you can
keep being you.



[Stoma Care] ;

### Stoma Care

Information, support and advice on post operative lifestyle for ileostomy, urostomy, colostomy and
general stoma care patients.
[Read more][224] [Advanced Wound Care] ;

### Advanced Wound Care

Leading the way in advanced wound and skin care innovation. Learn more about all our high quality
products to help heal wounds faster.
[Read more][225]




## Healthy Bonds. Our bonds determine who we are.

;

There’s no bond more important than the one with your own body. Convatec helps you create a healthy
bond with yourself, your stoma. And then, with the world around you.

Start creating a healthy bond with your stoma by finding the answers you need quickly with me+
Answers.

The me+™ programme offers you the right support so you feel stronger, more confident and ready for
what’s ahead. The ostomy products and support you need, tips and advice for stoma care, and a
community you can grow with. Have questions about living with an stoma? Our me+ specialists and
stoma nurses are waiting to help you, call 18002674989 or write to us at
customerserviceindia@convatec.com

[ Join me+ today ][226]

## Feature Highlight: AWC, CC, + Flexi-Seal

Hydrofiber® Technology

### Our Hydrofiber® Technology

**Hydrofiber^{®} Technology is a soft, absorbent material that transforms into a gel on contact with
wound fluid.**

For more than 25 years, Convatec has been helping clinicians to improve patient outcomes, enabling
patients to move on with their lives through the use of Hydrofiber^{®} Technology – globally proven
and trusted. Discover how the unique, innovative Hydrofiber^{®} Technology can help you make a real
impact on the lives of people living with a wound.

Our Hydrofiber® Technology Learn more

[ Learn more ][227] [three doctors] ; Flexi-Seal™

### Flexi-Seal™ FMS

Flexi-Seal™ Fecal Management System (FMS) is an indwelling fecal management catheter intended for
use to manage fecal incontinence through the collection of liquid to semi-liquid stool and to
provide access to administer medications.

Flexi-Seal™ FMS Learn more

[ Learn more ][228] [Flexi-Seal™ FMS] ;

Learning how to live fully with a condition takes education, resources and support. And with me+, we
make sure you don’t have to figure it out alone. Getting the benefits of me+ is easy. Join today for
complete support.

## The History of Henry Schein

[Henry Schein Cares]

In 1932, at the height of the Depression, a pharmacist named Henry Schein started our company with
the belief that we can fulfill our responsibilities as a corporate citizen by giving back to the
communities we serve. Ever since then, we have pursued the ideal of "doing well by doing good." This
spirit of individuals helping society is exemplified through Henry Schein Cares, our global
corporate social responsibility program.

  [ Our Businesses ][52]
  * [Pharmaceutical, Medical Supplies & Products Distribution Services][53]
    
    We distribute pharmaceuticals and medical supplies to healthcare settings across North America,
    from pharmacies and hospitals to doctors’ offices and clinics.
    * [Pharmaceutical Distribution Services][54]
    * [Medical Supply Distribution][55]
  * [Pharmacy Services][56]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.
  * [Oncology & Multispecialty Solutions][57]
    
    We provide research, insights, technologies and other support to help address challenges in
    cancer and specialty care.
  * [Biopharma Capabilities][58]
    
    We provide a suite of solutions designed to address access, affordability and adherence
    challenges by bridging the gaps between biopharma companies, pharmacies, providers, and payers
    to help patients get on and stay on their medications.
  * [Prescription Benefit Solutions][59]
    
    We offer solutions that enable employers, payers, health-plan brokers and government agencies to
    provide lower-cost options for prescription medications and therapies.
  * [Consumer Products & Services][60]
    
    We help to ensure the financial wellbeing of pharmacies and health systems and support a stable
    work environment for their employees.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

setting.]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur

Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

# Your Trusted Source for Security, AV and Smart Living Solutions

ADI is a leading distributor and solution provider of security, AV, and smart living products
serving over 100,000 customers worldwide. We offer access to a broad portfolio of products,
including top-tier distributed brands and our own exclusive brands.

With more than three decades of industry experience, we're committed to building long-lasting
customer relationships - making us a preferred partner for professionals across the industry.

# Our Mission

### We aim to provide products, services and software that help keep our communities safe, secure,
### comfortable and connected.

## Here's How We Do It

### Access to Exclusive Brands

We take pride in our exclusive, in-house manufactured products and software solutions, delivering
smart solutions that combine quality and innovation. From home automation to commercial-grade
infrastructure, we craft technologies that focus on what customers value most – delivering a
reliable and exceptional experience

[Access to Exclusive Brands]
[Support and Services]

### Support and Services

We offer a wide range of support and services to provide expert guidance at every step - from design
and configuration to ongoing support. With OvrC Remote Management, customers can easily manage,
configure, and troubleshoot devices across the network. OvrC is available on a range of exclusive
brand products and integrates with many leading distributed brands. Additional offerings include
systems design, technical support, rewards programs, training, project registration, and more.

### Robust Product Selection

With more than 500,000 products from over 1,000 trusted brands, ADI offers a carefully curated
selection of solutions to meet the needs for any application. We make purchasing easy - customers
can shop in-store or online and choose from multiple delivery options or in-store pickup.

## Write an investor-ready business plan from scratch

Most founder business plans never see an investor because they were written for the wrong audience
using the wrong template. The Business Plan Playbook Ebook is the founder-friendly guide to writing
a serious plan that actually gets read - covering structure, financial section depth, market sizing
and the narrative arc investors and lenders look for.

By the end you will have a business plan structure that works for both fundraising and operating,
plus the templates to fill it in.

## What's Inside the Business Plan Playbook Ebook

Every section is written to be read on a phone or a desktop, with the goal of getting you to action
faster.
* Comprehensive Checklist A detailed, actionable checklist that ensures you’ve covered every
  critical component of your business plan, from market research to financial forecasting and
  everything in between.
* Prompt Pack Get inspired with prompts that help you articulate your business goals, mission,
  vision, and strategies clearly and persuasively. Perfect for crafting investor-ready plans or
  improving internal alignment.
* Interactive Workbook A practical, hands-on workbook filled with exercises, frameworks, and
  templates to guide you through writing each section of your business plan.
* E-Book Dive deep into business planning with this expert-written e-book. It covers best practices,
  common mistakes to avoid, and actionable tips to create a plan that stands out.
* Step-by-Step Guide A user-friendly guide that simplifies the complex process of business planning.
  Follow this roadmap to ensure no detail is overlooked.
* Business Plan Template (Customizable for Any Business) Save time with a professionally designed
  business plan template that’s fully customizable. This template is available as an editable
  Word-Document for your convenience.
* Financial Plan Template Create a solid financial foundation for your business with a detailed
  financial plan template. Includes revenue projections, expense tracking, cash flow analysis, and
  break-even calculations, all tailored for startups and small businesses. This template is
  available in multiple currencies (USD, EUR, GBP) to suit your needs.
* Aspiring entrepreneurs looking to bring their ideas to life.

## Who This Ebook Is For
* Pre-seed and seed founders preparing fundraising materials
* Small business owners applying for bank loans or grants
* Side-hustlers formalising a real business plan for the first time
* Consultants writing business plans for their clients

## Format & Instant Delivery
* **Format:** Ebook (PDF)
* **Language:** English
* **Delivery:** Instant download by email after purchase
* **Works on:** iPad, Kindle, mobile, desktop - any device that opens PDFs

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How long should a business plan be?

20-40 pages is typical for investor plans, 15-25 for lender plans. The ebook covers the differences
in depth required for each audience.

### Do I need a full business plan or just a pitch deck?

Both serve different audiences. The ebook covers when a pitch deck is sufficient (most early-stage
VC conversations) and when a full plan is required (bank loans, grants, accelerators).

### How do I write the financial projections section?

The ebook walks through bottom-up financial modelling, key assumptions and the projection format
lenders and investors expect.

### Is there an AI tool for business plans?

Yes - Avvale's AI Business Plan Generator. The ebook covers how to use AI to draft a plan and the
editing layer required to make it investor-grade.

### How is this different from the bespoke business plan service?

This ebook teaches you to write your own plan. The bespoke service is a fully written plan by Avvale
consultants - we typically build these for live fundraising rounds where investor-grade depth is
required.

## Built by Avvale Consulting

Avvale Consulting has helped 300+ founders across 30+ countries raise capital and grow their
businesses since 2015. This ebook is the productised version of the knowledge we share with paying
clients - so you can apply it without the consulting bill.

## Write an investor-ready business plan from scratch

Most founder business plans never see an investor because they were written for the wrong audience
using the wrong template. The Business Plan Playbook Ebook is the founder-friendly guide to writing
a serious plan that actually gets read - covering structure, financial section depth, market sizing
and the narrative arc investors and lenders look for.

By the end you will have a business plan structure that works for both fundraising and operating,
plus the templates to fill it in.

## What's Inside the Business Plan Playbook Ebook

Every section is written to be read on a phone or a desktop, with the goal of getting you to action
faster.
* Comprehensive Checklist A detailed, actionable checklist that ensures you’ve covered every
  critical component of your business plan, from market research to financial forecasting and
  everything in between.
* Prompt Pack Get inspired with prompts that help you articulate your business goals, mission,
  vision, and strategies clearly and persuasively. Perfect for crafting investor-ready plans or
  improving internal alignment.
* Interactive Workbook A practical, hands-on workbook filled with exercises, frameworks, and
  templates to guide you through writing each section of your business plan.
* E-Book Dive deep into business planning with this expert-written e-book. It covers best practices,
  common mistakes to avoid, and actionable tips to create a plan that stands out.
* Step-by-Step Guide A user-friendly guide that simplifies the complex process of business planning.
  Follow this roadmap to ensure no detail is overlooked.
* Business Plan Template (Customizable for Any Business) Save time with a professionally designed
  business plan template that’s fully customizable. This template is available as an editable
  Word-Document for your convenience.
* Financial Plan Template Create a solid financial foundation for your business with a detailed
  financial plan template. Includes revenue projections, expense tracking, cash flow analysis, and
  break-even calculations, all tailored for startups and small businesses. This template is
  available in multiple currencies (USD, EUR, GBP) to suit your needs.

## Who This Ebook Is For
* Pre-seed and seed founders preparing fundraising materials
* Small business owners applying for bank loans or grants
* Side-hustlers formalising a real business plan for the first time
* Consultants writing business plans for their clients

## Format & Instant Delivery
* **Format:** Ebook (PDF)
* **Language:** English
* **Delivery:** Instant download by email after purchase
* **Works on:** iPad, Kindle, mobile, desktop - any device that opens PDFs

## Frequently Asked Questions

### How long should a business plan be?

20-40 pages is typical for investor plans, 15-25 for lender plans. The ebook covers the differences
in depth required for each audience.

### Do I need a full business plan or just a pitch deck?

Both serve different audiences. The ebook covers when a pitch deck is sufficient (most early-stage
VC conversations) and when a full plan is required (bank loans, grants, accelerators).

### How do I write the financial projections section?

The ebook walks through bottom-up financial modelling, key assumptions and the projection format
lenders and investors expect.

### Is there an AI tool for business plans?

Yes - Avvale's AI Business Plan Generator. The ebook covers how to use AI to draft a plan and the
editing layer required to make it investor-grade.

### How is this different from the bespoke business plan service?

This ebook teaches you to write your own plan. The bespoke service is a fully written plan by Avvale
consultants - we typically build these for live fundraising rounds where investor-grade depth is
required.

## Built by Avvale Consulting

Avvale Consulting has helped 300+ founders across 30+ countries raise capital and grow their
businesses since 2015. This ebook is the productised version of the knowledge we share with paying
clients - so you can apply it without the consulting bill.

When to Contact your Stoma Nurse?

You should contact your stoma nurse if you experience:
* Skin irritation around the stoma that does not improve.
* Leakage issues with your pouching system.
* Changes in your stoma’s size, color, or shape.
* Pain or discomfort that persists.
* Frequent pouch detachment or difficulty securing the system.

How to Measure your Stoma?
* Use a measuring guide – Many ostomy supply manufacturers provide templates to ensure the correct
  fit.
* Measure at the base – Place the guide around your stoma to get an accurate measurement.
* Allow space for movement – Cut the skin barrier 1/8 inch (3mm) larger than your stoma to avoid
  irritation.
* Check for leaks – Ensure a snug fit without gaps.
How Long is the Average Wear Time?
* Standard wear time for an ostomy pouch and skin barrier is 3 to 7 days, depending on activity
  level, skin type, and the product used.
* Using skin barrier rings and pastes can extend wear time and provide better adhesion.
Can you sleep with an Ostomy?

Yes, you can sleep comfortably with an ostomy by:
* Using a high-capacity pouch to avoid frequent emptying.
* Sleeping on your back or side to prevent pressure on the stoma.
* Securing your pouch with a support belt to prevent movement.
* Emptying the pouch before bed to reduce the risk of leaks.

# Foley-Safe™: Advanced Catheter Securement and Stability

Foley-Safe™ is an innovative catheter securement device developed to actively help reduce the risk
of Catheter-Associated Urinary Tract Infections (CAUTI) and prevent unintended Foley catheter
extractions. This stabilization solution is designed to support clinicians in everyday urology care
by addressing the clinical challenges associated with long-term dwelling catheters.

**
Advanced Movement Control: **The device utilizes a specialized mechanism to absorb micro-movements,
effectively reducing the mechanical stress on the catheter that can lead to irritation and infection
risk.
**
Safety-Focused Design: **In the event of sudden pulling, the integrated safety disconnection feature
allows for controlled release. This is designed to protect the patient from potential bladder and
urethral injury, supporting safer clinical outcomes.
**
Improved Patient Experience: **By providing superior stability and minimizing unnecessary catheter
movement, Foley-Safe™ helps reduce patient discomfort and supports an improved quality of life.

# Foley-Safe™: Advanced Catheter Securement and Stability

Foley-Safe™ is an innovative catheter securement device developed to actively help reduce the risk
of Catheter-Associated Urinary Tract Infections (CAUTI) and prevent unintended Foley catheter
extractions. This stabilization solution is designed to support clinicians in everyday urology care
by addressing the clinical challenges associated with long-term dwelling catheters.

**
Advanced Movement Control: **The device utilizes a specialized mechanism to absorb micro-movements,
effectively reducing the mechanical stress on the catheter that can lead to irritation and infection
risk.
**
Safety-Focused Design: **In the event of sudden pulling, the integrated safety disconnection feature
allows for controlled release. This is designed to protect the patient from potential bladder and
urethral injury, supporting safer clinical outcomes.
**
Improved Patient Experience: **By providing superior stability and minimizing unnecessary catheter
movement, Foley-Safe™ helps reduce patient discomfort and supports an improved quality of life.

Reduces pain, and improves self-confidence and the patient’s quality of life

## Testimonials

Dr. Aaron (Roni) Manes
Urologist Surgeon

We, as Doctors, are aware of many cases in which unconscious patients are pulling out the catheter
because the uncomfortable feeling it causes. By doing so they are harming themselves, causing
sometime irreversible damage. FoleySafe certainly avoids such damages. Moreover, FoleySafe avoids
dislodgment, and by doing so reduces drastically the danger of Catheter Associated Urinary Tract
Infection (CAUTI).

Haim Bibi
Professor of Pediatric Pediatric intensive care

I examined FoleySafe carefully. Because Foley catheter is stabilized in the bladder with a balloon,
the unstable balloon position may cause an uncomfortable sensation to the patient. Furthermore, in
many cases, the patients have a tendency of pulling the balloon inflated catheter out of the body.
The pulling out maneuver either causing damage (sometime irreversible) to the bladder and/or to the
urethra. Foley-Safe can avoid these uneven situations. Since I have very good experience with
FoleySafe apparatus, I can certainly recommend the usage of the FoleySafe at hospital setting for
both children and adults' applications.

Prof. Shmuel Cytron
Urologist

Unconscious urinary catheter extraction is a very frequent occurrence and with a very high potential
of adverse consequences. I have examined the latest produced FoleySafe devices and in my opinion, it
is the ultimate response in order to:
•Prevent catheter dislodgment and reduce the risk of Catheter Associated Urinary Tract Infection
(CAUTI)
•Prevent unconscious extraction by cutting the catheter and releasing the sterile fluid from the
catheter bulb I warmly recommended the usage of the FoleySafe in the hospital I am working with. it
is the best solution up to date

Before using Foley-Safe 2.0, I was constantly dealing with catheter movement, irritation and
inflammation. Every small movement caused pulling, pain, and sometimes even infections that sent me
back to the hospital. Since switching to Foley-Safe 2.0, I haven’t had a single UTI. The stabilizer
holds the catheter securely, limits movement, and I feel so much more comfortable. Thanks to
Cathetrix’s design, I’ve reduced hospital visits and can finally go about my day without pain or
worry. Highly recommended

After surgery, I came home with an indwelling catheter and constant discomfort. The tube pulled, the
area got sore, and I even developed mild inflammation. I was afraid to move at all. Once I started
using Foley-Safe 2.0, that changed completely. The stabilizer prevented excessive movement, reduced
irritation, and gave me confidence to walk again. My mobility improved, and the risk of
catheter-associated UTI dropped dramatically. Cathetrix truly delivered what they promised.

Having a catheter felt embarrassing at first. I avoided going out or even moving much. When I
started using Foley-Safe 2.0, I felt secure again. It holds everything firmly, so I can walk, sit,
and even go for short trips without fear. It’s discreet, comfortable, and made me feel like myself
again. I never realized how much confidence I’d lost until I got it back.

## A Little About CSD Credit Union

In 1959, CSD Credit Union was formed to provide the employees of CSD-1 (Hickman Mills School
District) with an alternative to traditional for profit banking institutions. The first
organizational meeting of the credit union was held in the Ruskin Cafeteria on March 19th, 1959.

# Welcome to Dräger in India

**Turning technology into “Technology for Life”**

Dräger manufactures medical and safety technology products. In so doing, we protect, support, and
save people's lives around the world in hospitals, with fire departments, emergency services,
authorities, and in mining as well as industry. Founded in Lübeck in 1889, Dräger has grown into a
worldwide, listed enterprise in its fifth generation as a family-run business. Dräger has more than
16,000 employees worldwide and is present in over 190 countries around the globe. In 2023, the
company generated net sales of around EUR 3.4 billion.

Dräger technology is used all over the world. We operate in around 50 countries with our own sales
and service companies directly on location where our customers are.

Improving critical care is what drives us. Learn how our solutions can help you protect, support and
save lives – across departments and across your hospital.

focus is to keep you safe on the job.

[Learn more][85]
[contact-us_safety-3-2]

#### Contact

# Welcome to Dräger in India

**Turning technology into “Technology for Life”**

Dräger manufactures medical and safety technology products. In so doing, we protect, support, and
save people's lives around the world in hospitals, with fire departments, emergency services,
authorities, and in mining as well as industry. Founded in Lübeck in 1889, Dräger has grown into a
worldwide, listed enterprise in its fifth generation as a family-run business. Dräger has more than
16,000 employees worldwide and is present in over 190 countries around the globe. In 2023, the
company generated net sales of around EUR 3.4 billion.

Dräger technology is used all over the world. We operate in around 50 countries with our own sales
and service companies directly on location where our customers are.

[male-doctor-3-2-D-30493-2017]

Improving critical care is what drives us. Learn how our solutions can help you protect, support and
save lives – across departments and across your hospital.

[Learn more][84]

Dräger is a globally recognised name in the field of safety technology. No matter your industry, our
focus is to keep you safe on the job.

[Learn more][85]
[contact-us_safety-3-2]

#### Contact

[xnode]

#### Dräger X-node

Dräger X-node is a wireless IoT solution for process monitoring and analysis. The system solution
converts reliable measurement data - gas concentration, temperature, humidity and pressure - from
the X-node device into valuable information that you can access, analyse, visualise, monitor and
store online via the X-node Hub.

[Learn more][90]
[X-plore-8300-carpentry-3-2]

#### Dräger X-plore 8300

Reliable respiratory protection against harmful particles with no noticeable breathing resistance or
restriction to movement: The Dräger X-plore 8300 is the smallest and lightest PAPR device in its
class, offering maximum protection and comfort.

[Learn more][91]
[Main-Suraksha-Parmo-Dharma-v2-3-2]

#### Suraksha Parmo Dharma

As trusted partners, we are dedicated to ensuring that no matter the complexity of the task, you
have Dräger's unwavering support. 

Suraksha Parmo Dharma, a Sanskrit maxim, it means safety is the highest duty. In an era where
workplace hazards, industrial accidents and emergency response risks persist.

[Learn more][92]
[IN-CSR-PCVC-3-2]

#### CSR Initiative Supported by Dräger Safety India

Dräger Safety India proudly announces its successful CSR initiative with PCVC, supporting survivors
of domestic and interpersonal violence, highlighting our commitment to protecting and saving lives.

[Learn more][93]

## Dutch Diagnostics Human and Animal Care

Dutch Diagnostics – Human and Animal Care-  is a worldwide supplier of In Vitro Diagnostics. Rapid
Test, Clinical Chemistry, Coagulation Analyzers, Urinalysis are our main specialties in our vast and
expanding portfolio.

## ABOUT DUTCH DIAGNOSTICS

## Welcome to Dutch Diagnostics

We are a worldwide supplier of Clinical Chemistry, Urinalysis, Rapid Tests and Coagulation. It is
our mission to provide you with all your diagnostic needs. We pride ourselves on our quality of
products and making it our mission to make our services just as high. Because of our ISO 13485
certification and years of experience with IVD. We can deliver ready-to-use private labels for your
company or directly to your customers. For more information, please contact us or speak to one of
our Sales Managers.

Dutch Diagnostics was founded in 2000. Since then, we have gradually became a worldwide supplier of
Clinical Chemistry, Urinalysis, Rapid Tests and Coagulation.

### Mission Statement

Since Dutch Diagnostics was founded (Mr. Patrick Govaers Sr.) we always only had one main goal: to
offer excellent quality products worldwide for a fair price. We are very proud that in the last 20
years we succeeded in finding solid distributors and loyal clients in over 80 countries worldwide.

We are always open to new distributors and new products. Contact us if your company would be a solid
partner for Dutch Diagnostics.

## SERVICES

## We're Worldwide Supplier

Dutch Diagnostics is an ISO 13485 Certified company & We have become a worldwide supplier of
Clinical Chemistry, Urinalysis, Rapid Tests and Coagulation.

### Dedication

We are dedicated to keep our customers 100% satisfied. Our staff is regularly trained to keep the
quality standards high. We organise in-house trainings for our employees so they are always capable
of supporting our customers in every situation.

### Local Support

We can support you with flyers and folders to support your local selling activities. We can also
send you these in digital format so you can translate them into you own local language when needed.

### Customer Service

Customer Service is one of our top priorities. We do care about our customers - small or big - and
we always strive to answer any request within 24 hours. You can contact us by Phone, Email or Fax.
Our Customer Service can be reached from Monday to Friday from 08:30 - 17:00.

### Manuals & Inserts

On request we can provide the test manuals. These manuals are always included by all of our
products. Just as the boxes, its possible to adjust the manuals to you’re own brand. This will be of
course done within the IVD-regulation’s. If you want to know more about the options for your
company, please contact us with any questions you may have.

### Experience

We have over 20 years of expertise in IVD diagnostics. Our long-standing partnerships and deep
industry knowledge allow us to provide reliable products and exceptional service. We continuously
adapt to advancements to meet the needs of our customers worldwide.

### Training

We offer training programs to enhance the use of our products for our customers and their staff. Our
employees receive regular retraining to maintain our knowledge excellence. Training can be provided
at our office in The Netherlands or in collaboration with partners on site. Contact us for
customized advice on our contact page.

## Our Products Categories

## Urinalysis

Our urine test strips are produced in Germany. The tests are available in different versions for
visually reading and for automated reading with the easy-to-use and compact POCT 100 test strip
reader.

We are proud to offer you a complete line in clinical chemistry. High quality reagents produced in

# **FlexGRIP, the next-generation** in catheter stabilization.

Flexible enough to allow for patients’ natural movement while firmly securing the catheter to
prevent migration and dislodgment and reduce complications.

[Discover FlexGRIP][31]

## Neonate

**Zinc Oxide Adhesive
**Stays adherent in high humidity incubators. Safe and gentle for delicate neonatal skin.

## Pediatric

**Proprietary Hydrocolloid Adhesive
**Safe on Pediatric Skin.
Designed to prevent MARSIs.

## Adult

**Advanced Acrylic Adhesive
**Setting the Standard.
No skin prep needed.
Removes Safely without alcohol.
[Pause video][Play video]
**Featured**

## FlexGRIP Alpha

Unrivaled securement for catheters with suture wings, including CVCs and arterial lines.

[View Product][32]

## Explore our catheter stabilization solutions.

[Neonate][33]
[Pediatric][34]
[Adult][35]

## Hear how FlexGRIP is making a difference

[See Testimonials][36]

Before using FlexGRIP, my sutures failed constantly, forcing me to visit the hospital three to four
times a week. **Since switching to FlexGRIP, my life has completely changed—the catheter stays
securely in place**, and I’ve even started driving again. I can’t imagine my life without it.

**Johan Legrand | Patient**
FlexGRIP Product

**FlexGRIP has truly transformed my life. **No more painful stitching, sedation, or discomfort after
catheter changes. I feel more secure, mobile, and free to enjoy sports and social activities. My
sleep has improved, hospital visits are less frequent, and I have more time to focus on living
instead of managing my condition. It’s not just a securement device—it’s a game-changer for my
health and quality of life.

**Edith De Landsheer | Cancer Patient**
FlexGRIP Product

After a successful drainage procedure, catheter fixation is just as crucial as the drain itself.
**The FlexGRIP stands out by combining durability, skin-friendly adhesion, and secure yet
comfortable immobilization.** It brings together the best features of existing systems, setting a
new standard in catheter stabilization.

**Dr. Geert Verswijfel | Interventional Radiologist, ZOL**
FlexGRIP Product

## Innovation runs in our veins.

Our leaders are passionate about improving patient care and meeting the needs of those delivering
care.

are not intended to specify or limit product usage to any particular patient population. Product
selection should be based on individual clinical needs, including factors such as skin condition,
anatomical location, and performance requirements, irrespective of patient age. While certain
product configurations, may be commonly selected in specific clinical contexts, they may be equally

# We are a Branding + Digital Marketing Agency, helping you improve your brand image, grow your
# business and generate more sales.

## WHAT WE DO

# We are a full-service agency based in Johor Bahru, Malaysia specialising in healthcare,
# hospitality, lifestyle, corporate, retail and more.

## OUR CAPABILITIES

### Strategy

Greatness can only be achieved with a solid strategy. We create strategic value through a strong
vision and clear brand positioning to improve your competitive position and manage business risk.

[VIEW MORE][6]

### Branding

We uncover the heart of your business and develop brands that embody your values. Whether you’re
launching a brand or refreshing your identity, we use design and storytelling to capture and excite
your audiences.

[VIEW MORE][7]

### Digital

Our goal is to drive revenue and leads for you. Using the core digital marketing channels - SEO,
Paid Search, Display and Social Media Advertising - to create effective, successful marketing
campaigns.

[VIEW MORE][8]

# You run the company. We run the paperwork.

Register an official South African company, manage finances, stay compliant, file taxes, send
invoices, and get paid. All in one place.

[Register a company][3]

R950 once-off, CIPC fee included. About a week.

[Get a free company health check][4]

Takes a few minutes.

## What Govchain does

Govchain is a South African platform for starting and running a company. We register your company
with CIPC, then keep it compliant with CIPC and SARS: annual returns, beneficial ownership, company
tax, VAT and payroll, all from one account. More than 124 000 South African business owners use
Govchain. [Compare our plans and pricing][5].

## All the essentials, none of the hassle.

Govchain handles the complex tasks, like registration and compliance, and automates the mundane work
so you can focus on what matters most. See [the full list of services][6] for the one-off jobs we
file with CIPC and SARS.

[Make it official]
Company Registration

### Make it official

Start your business in just a few clicks. Receive all the necessary documents for your private
company (Pty) Ltd directly in your inbox. Quick, simple, and hassle-free.

[Explore company registration][7]
[Stay compliant]
Filings

### Stay compliant

Stay on top of your filing deadlines. Govchain Filings™ handles the hard parts, keeps you
penalty-free, and makes compliance stress-free.

[Explore filings][8]
[Manage finances]
Bookkeeping

### Manage finances

No more complicated software or costly bookkeepers. Govchain Books™ lets you send invoices, receive
payments, and file taxes, all in one place.

[Explore bookkeeping][9]
[File taxes]
Taxes

### File taxes

Filing company tax returns doesn't need to be complicated. Govchain Tax™ takes care of everything,
from start to finish.

[Explore company tax][10]

## Here’s why small business owners love Govchain

Govchain has helped over 124 000 small business owners in South Africa simplify starting their
businesses and staying compliant.

## For Patients, By Patients – Redefining Catheter Care.

### Redefining Catheter Care for Greater Comfort and Independence

Invomed is a woman-owned, disabled-owned medical device company based in Vancouver, Washington,
dedicated to improving the daily lives of people who depend on long-term medical devices. Guided by
real patient experience and a deep understanding of the challenges faced by catheter users, Invomed
develops innovative solutions designed to enhance comfort, safety, and independence. Our products
are created for individuals living with chronic conditions, as well as the clinicians,
rehabilitation specialists, and healthcare providers who support them. By combining thoughtful
design with practical functionality, Invomed addresses everyday problems that traditional devices
often overlook.

[Learn More][15]

### The Drake Lock & Swivel: A New Standard in Catheter Stabilization

The Drake Lock & Swivel represents a breakthrough in catheter securement technology. Unlike
traditional stabilization methods that rely on strong adhesives, this patented device provides
secure catheter stabilization while allowing natural movement through its innovative swivel
mechanism. Designed to minimize skin irritation and reduce the risk of accidental dislodgement, the
Drake Lock & Swivel offers a more comfortable and reliable solution for long-term catheter users. By
prioritizing mobility and patient comfort, the device supports both clinical effectiveness and
improved daily living for individuals who rely on catheterization.

[View Details][16]

### Patented Retainer

The Drake Lock & Swivel Retainer is a patented catheter stabilization device designed to provide
secure support while allowing natural movement for long-term catheter users in daily life. Its
innovative swivel design helps reduce tension, discomfort, and the risk of catheter dislodgement,
giving patients greater comfort and mobility in their daily lives.

### Swiveling Retainer

It features an innovative swiveling retainer that moves naturally with the patient, allowing the
catheter to rotate freely without kinking, twisting, or tugging during normal daily movement. This
design reduces strain on the catheter and surrounding skin while maintaining secure stabilization,
helping improve mobility, comfort, and confidence during everyday activities.


More

### Adhesive-Free Security

Strong adhesives can irritate skin and limit inspection. The Drake Lock & Swivel uses silicone grip
strips to stay secure while protecting skin.

### Swiveling Retainer

The integrated swivel allows the catheter to move naturally with the body, reducing pulling,
kinking, and tension while improving freedom of movement.

### Universal Fit

Patented retainer channels securely hold nearly any two-port catheter—latex or silicone—in either
direction for flexible use.

More


[Shop on Amazon][17]
Virginia Jennings

When my husband, a 100% disabled veteran, had his first back surgery in July 2023, he was fitted
with an indwelling catheter. In the hospital, they used the stick on Statlock devices. It wasn't
till we got home, a month later, that I discovered those devices had basically been eating away at
his skin, and trying to find another place to stick them was becoming increasingly difficult.

At the time, I was searching for all the info I could find on catheters and joined a couple of
Facebook groups. In that group, I met Michelle Drake and found out about her leg strap. So I ordered
one. It was a GAME CHANGER!! We could finally get my husband's leg sores to heal. The strap
securement device swivels like the Statlock device, which is important to keep the catheter from
kinking. The strap itself is soft, yet has good grippiness to it, keeping it securely in place. And
the velcro!! Super strong and long lasting. We even use it in the pool! And lastly, you can switch
legs easily, something you cannot do with the stick on devices.

I've since recommended this strap to everyone on the support sites I'm on as well as telling Drs and
nurses about it. I'm so grateful for Michelle and hope this strap becomes the norm everywhere!

Andrea Hunt

After having a catheter for 2 years and learning I would have it for the rest of my life I began
looking for more life-living appropriate supplies.   

There are some great options out there but for long term use they all seemed to have issues. 

  A fellow catheter user suggested the Drake Lock and Swivel and WOW!   

I can't say enough about this item. It is made out of high quality and durable supplies, fully
adjustable with wide elastic and strong velcro. Due to the anti slip grip on the inner side there is
no reason to attach the strap snuggly

After having a catheter for 2 years and learning I would have it for the rest of my life I began
looking for more life-living appropriate supplies.   

There are some great options out there but for long term use they all seemed to have issues. 

  A fellow catheter user suggested the Drake Lock and Swivel and WOW!   

I can't say enough about this item. It is made out of high quality and durable supplies, fully
adjustable with wide elastic and strong velcro. Due to the anti slip grip on the inner side there is
no reason to attach the strap snuggly so it is very comfortable.   

I switch my catheter from a leg bag and bed bag and the swivel feature makes this a comfortable
exchange since it allows the bag/tubing to rest where it is needed and most comfortable.   

Previous items I have used needed to be replaced frequently. On occasion I have been able to
"stretch" previous straps to last up to one month but I would say that on average they were only in
good shape for about 2 weeks. I've had the same Drake straps (2) for 6 months and with regular
washing they are both in good condition.    

I have also been impressed with Michelle, the creator of this device. She saw a need and invented a
fix! I have been able to communicate directly with her and when there was a delay in my delivery
since she was out of town she compensated me with an additional strap!   

I come from a 25+ year nursing career and when I began working there was no stabilizing devices that
I was aware of....we used tape to create something to try to help with this issue. I never really
considered how ineffective those were until I required a catheter myself. Having this device
available for those in acute care situations would be such a beneficial asset to their general
comfort level.   

Thank you for the opportunity to share my story and for helping to benefit the catheter community.

Darienne McAuley

Something that's made a huge difference to me is now wearing a Drake Lock and Swivel leg band. I
remember that it was mentioned a while back and so I looked it up recently and sent away for it. No
more tape on the deteriorating skin on my thigh to keep the catheter where I want it. And it means
that I can put the catheter high on my thigh thus giving me maximum play in the tubing. This means
that my tender lady parts are far less subject to being irritated by the catheter tubing and that's
a major positive. And no more twisting of the tubing thus cutting off the free flowing of the urine.

I wish I'd known about this devise right from the start. I should add that the website owner was a
pleasure to deal with.

Feb 12, 2025
Lorenzo W.

I’ve had problems with adhesives irritating my skin, so I was really excited to find this product
after hearing about it in an online support group. One of the members shared how it helped her
husband with the same issues, so I decided to give it a try. Since using it, my skin feels so much
better, and I am really happy with how breathable it is. I am wearing it right now and plan to keep
ordering. It’s been a big difference for me!

Feb 20, 2025

650,000+ sq.ft.

GMP 10,000-level cleanroom

The story began in the early 1990s, when the professional team at KB Medical Group, through
long-term collaboration with clinical medical institutions, discovered that the infection rate of
surgical wounds remained high. They also found that conventional surgical films and dressings were
one of the main reasons for poor wound healing. In order to alleviate this suffering for more
patients, KB R&D team began working on the development of high-end surgical films and dressings.

# KB MEDICAL (GROUP), INC

650,000+ sq.ft.

GMP 10,000-level cleanroom

The story began in the early 1990s, when the professional team at KB Medical Group, through
long-term collaboration with clinical medical institutions, discovered that the infection rate of
surgical wounds remained high. They also found that conventional surgical films and dressings were
one of the main reasons for poor wound healing. In order to alleviate this suffering for more
patients, KB R&D team began working on the development of high-end surgical films and dressings.

  management, establishing a rigorous, standardized, and world-class comprehensive quality
  management system.

  Customized service
  Ksure Wound Dressing can be customized to fit different customers' demands, which helps minimize

## Unique Solutions for Catheter Stabilization

Delivering modern medical solutions, inspired by personal experiences, to better the daily lives of
those experiencing critical and chronic conditions.

[Learn More][22]
[Team of Scientists Doing Research for Clinical Validations]

###### New Product Development

## Our Process

We began our journey with the dream of helping one child and quickly realized that we weren’t
dreaming big enough. Through our innovative New Product Development process, we’ve made that dream
available to patients of all shapes and sizes.

[Lecs]

We’re revolutionizing catheter stabilization, not just because we want to help others during this
process, but because we’ve been there too.

[View Products][24]
[lecs 1 catheter stabilization device]

### LECS I

With its distinctive lizard tongue locking mechanism, this device works with a straight catheter,
allowing for intermittent drainage, fewer leaks, and stabilization within a stoma.
View LECS I
[View LECS I][25]
[lecs 2 catheter stabilization device]

### LECS II

It rotates! With a rotatable head of up to 180 degrees, this device allows for the stabilization of
a Foley 2-way catheter, reducing trauma to the urethra and allowing for comfortable wear while doing
normal everyday activities.
View LECS II
[View LECS II][26]
[lecs 3 catheter stabilization device]

### LECS III

A variation of LECS II, this device also has a rotating head of up to 180 degrees, allowing for
stabilization of a Foley 3-way catheter.

Our team is standing by to talk to you. We’re here to answer any questions you might have or to

With its distinctive lizard tongue locking mechanism, this device works with a straight catheter,
allowing for intermittent drainage, fewer leaks, and stabilization within a stoma.

### LECS II

It rotates! With a rotatable head of up to 180 degrees, this device allows for the stabilization of
a Foley 2-way catheter, reducing trauma to the urethra and allowing for comfortable wear while doing
normal everyday activities.

stabilization of a Foley 3-way catheter.

take the time to listen to what’s important to you before recommending next steps.

[national recognition icon]

### National recognition:

Cleveland Clinic is recognized in the U.S. and throughout the world for its expertise and care.

[skilled and collaborative providers icon]

### Collaborative providers:

You’ll get care from board-certified and fellowship trained experts who work together to create a
treatment plan just for you. Only the highest standards ensure [excellent outcomes][66].

[Innovation and Research Icon]

### Innovation and research:

We’re focused on today — and tomorrow. Our focus on [research][67] and offering the latest options
means you can find a wide range of [clinical trials][68] and other care that you can’t find
elsewhere.

## For Providers

Explore a curated collection of helpful resources and tools for medical professionals

### Institutes & Departments

Connect with expert teams across our [Institutes and Departments][91] to collaborate on patient care
and drive better outcomes.

### Join Our Nursing Team

Whether you’re just graduating from nursing school or have years of experience, you can build an
exceptional career in [nursing at Cleveland Clinic][92].

### Careers

As one of the nation’s — and the world’s — leading academic medical centers, you can grow in a
setting where you’ll make a difference. [Find your career][93] at Cleveland Clinic.

### Refer a Patient

We welcome the opportunity to partner with you in caring for your patients. Our dedicated [Referring
Physician team][94] is available from 7 a.m. to 7 p.m. EST every day for you and your patients.

### ConsultQD

A [site for physicians and healthcare professionals][95] from Cleveland Clinic. Discover the latest
research insights, innovations and treatment trends.

### Education

We’re dedicated to training the next generation of healthcare professionals. Explore the [training
and education programs][96] we offer worldwide.

### Research

We’re committed to improving care and finding tomorrow’s cures. Learn about our [cutting-edge basic,
translational and clinical research][97].

View our [full list of resources][98] for medical professionals, including our Alumni Association,
DrConnect, and MyPractice.

# Welcome to MRIsafety.com!

Your Resource for MRI Safety, Bioeffects,
& Patient Management

MRIsafety.com is the premier information resource for magnetic resonance safety.

### ** [**MRI BIOEFFECTS, SAFETY, AND PATIENT MANAGEMENT: SECOND EDITION book available at
### Amazon.com**][3] **
### (**PDF version** is available at [**MRIsafetybook.com)**][4]

**MRIsafety.com is Exclusively Sponsored by BRACCO**
     [[Bracco]][5]

[7Tesla]

## Testing, Training, and Books

## Implant & Device Testing

MAGNETIC RESONANCE SAFETY TESTING SERVICES is a highly experienced MRI-safety testing company that
conducts comprehensive evaluations of implants, devices, objects, and materials. For information,
visit [**MagneticResonanceSafetyTesting.com**][6]

### MRI Textbook

**MRI BIOEFFECTS, SAFETY, AND PATIENT MANAGEMENT: SECOND EDITION.** A comprehensive, authoritative
textbook on MRI health & safety concerns with contributions from more than fifty internationally
respected experts in the field. This is the definitive textbook on MRI safety for radiologists and
other physicians, MRI technologists, physicists, scientists, MRI facility managers, and others. Book
version is available on [**Amazon.com**][7]. The **PDF version** is available at
[**MRIsafetybook.com**][8]

### MRI Safety Training

Training is available through AppliedRadiology.com. Programs for MR personnel include: "Introduction
to MRI Safety", "Basic MRI Safety Training", and "Advanced MRI Safety Training For Healthcare
Professionals". Please visit: [appliedradiology.org/MRISafety/][9]

### IMRSER

The Institute for Magnetic Resonance Safety, Education, and Research (IMRSER) was formed in response
to the growing need for information and research regarding MRI safety. IMRSER promotes awareness,
understanding, and communication of MR safety issues through education and research. Visit:
[**IMRSER.org**][10]

### MRI Safety Videos

Videos Available on IMRSER include: MRI Safety Training Programs for Levels 1 and 2 MR Personnel,
What to Expect During Your MRI, Projectile/Missile Effect videos, and Superconducting magnet
quenching shown from both inside and outside the MR system room. Visit: [**IMRSER Videos**][11]

## Resources Available on MRIsafety.com

### "The List"

Find safety related information pertaining to thousands of specific implants or devices.
* [Search The List][12]

### Safety Information Topics

Quickly search hundreds of MRI safety related articles.
* [Search Articles][13]

### Screening Form

Download MRI pre-screening forms for patients and MR personnel. English and Spanish forms are
available.
* [More Info & Download][14]

### Product Testing

Information of MRI testing of medical implants, materials, and devices performed by Magnetic
Resonance Safety Testing Services. Testing procedures are in accordance with the guidelines from The
American Society for Testing and Materials (ASTM) International.
* [More Info][15]

### Biomedical Lectures

Dr. Shellock is regularly invited to lecture at national and international scientific and medical
conferences and meetings. He is available to lecture on several magnetic resonance safety topics:
* [More Info][16]

### About Dr. Shellock

Frank G. Shellock, Ph.D. is a physiologist with more than 30 years of experience conducting
laboratory and clinical investigations in the field of magnetic resonance imaging.
* [More][17]


© by Shellock R & D Services, Inc. and Frank G. Shellock, Ph.D. All rights reserved.

## Menu
* [Homepage][18]
* [The LIST and
     Safety Topics][19]
* [Info & Terminology][20]
* [Screening Form][21]
* [Product Testing][22]
* [Lectures][23]
* [Disclaimer][24]
* [About Dr. Shellock][25]
* [Priority Email][26]

## Accidents

An office chair was in the wrong place - at ANY time!

Floor polishers are poor MRI system cleaners!

A steel oxygen tank is never permitted inside of the MRI system room.

## Get in touch

   Frank.ShellockREMOVE@MRIsafety.com.

### Amazon.com**][3] **

[7Tesla]

## Testing, Training, and Books

## Implant & Device Testing

MAGNETIC RESONANCE SAFETY TESTING SERVICES is a highly experienced MRI-safety testing company that
conducts comprehensive evaluations of implants, devices, objects, and materials. For information,
visit [**MagneticResonanceSafetyTesting.com**][6]

### MRI Textbook

**MRI BIOEFFECTS, SAFETY, AND PATIENT MANAGEMENT: SECOND EDITION.** A comprehensive, authoritative
textbook on MRI health & safety concerns with contributions from more than fifty internationally
respected experts in the field. This is the definitive textbook on MRI safety for radiologists and
other physicians, MRI technologists, physicists, scientists, MRI facility managers, and others. Book
version is available on [**Amazon.com**][7]. The **PDF version** is available at
[**MRIsafetybook.com**][8]

### MRI Safety Training

Training is available through AppliedRadiology.com. Programs for MR personnel include: "Introduction
to MRI Safety", "Basic MRI Safety Training", and "Advanced MRI Safety Training For Healthcare
Professionals". Please visit: [appliedradiology.org/MRISafety/][9]

### IMRSER

The Institute for Magnetic Resonance Safety, Education, and Research (IMRSER) was formed in response
to the growing need for information and research regarding MRI safety. IMRSER promotes awareness,
understanding, and communication of MR safety issues through education and research. Visit:
[**IMRSER.org**][10]

### MRI Safety Videos

Videos Available on IMRSER include: MRI Safety Training Programs for Levels 1 and 2 MR Personnel,
What to Expect During Your MRI, Projectile/Missile Effect videos, and Superconducting magnet
quenching shown from both inside and outside the MR system room. Visit: [**IMRSER Videos**][11]

## Resources Available on MRIsafety.com

### "The List"

Find safety related information pertaining to thousands of specific implants or devices.
* [Search The List][12]

### Safety Information Topics

Quickly search hundreds of MRI safety related articles.
* [Search Articles][13]

### Screening Form

Download MRI pre-screening forms for patients and MR personnel. English and Spanish forms are
available.
* [More Info & Download][14]

### Product Testing

Information of MRI testing of medical implants, materials, and devices performed by Magnetic
Resonance Safety Testing Services. Testing procedures are in accordance with the guidelines from The
American Society for Testing and Materials (ASTM) International.
* [More Info][15]

### Biomedical Lectures

Dr. Shellock is regularly invited to lecture at national and international scientific and medical
conferences and meetings. He is available to lecture on several magnetic resonance safety topics:
* [More Info][16]

### About Dr. Shellock

Frank G. Shellock, Ph.D. is a physiologist with more than 30 years of experience conducting
laboratory and clinical investigations in the field of magnetic resonance imaging.

Research outputs designed to plug directly into planning, investment and board level discussions.

sources.

#### Analytics and Modelling

indicators.

#### Insight Development

Senior analysts translate findings into clear storylines and strategic implications.

#### Actionable Deliverables

Concrete recommendations, prioritised actions and quantified impact ranges.

#### Follow Through and Measurement

Support in defining KPIs and tracking how decisions influence revenue, margin and risk over time.

## Your Trusted Partner in Market and Revenue Intelligence

Strategic Revenue Insights is part of SRI Consulting Group Ltd and focuses on one thing: helping
organisations make better revenue decisions.

### Informed Strategic Planning

We give strategy, finance and business leaders a common, fact-based view of the markets they operate
in. This reduces debate about “what is true” and shifts the conversation to “what should we do
next”.

### Stronger Investment and Portfolio Choices

By linking market outlooks to product, geography and customer portfolios, we help you decide where
to expand, where to hold and where to exit. The result is sharper focus and better use of capital.

Clear evidence and simple narratives make it easier to align leadership teams, secure stakeholder
buy in and move at speed. Our team remains available beyond the report handover to test assumptions
and refine plans.

# Treaton — Your Trusted Partner in Medical Equipment for Anesthesiology and Intensive Care

Treaton (Triton Electronic Systems Ltd.) is a leading Russian manufacturer specializing in the
development, production, and full-service support of high-tech medical equipment for anesthesiology,
intensive care units (ICU), resuscitation, and emergency medicine. With more than 35 years of
experience, we deliver reliable, innovative, and safe solutions that medical professionals trust
every day.

Our equipment is successfully used by leading medical institutions, including the Ministry of
Health, Ministry of Internal Affairs, Ministry of Defense, and Ministry of Emergency Situations of
the Russian Federation, as well as by partners in over 40 countries worldwide.

## Comprehensive Range of Medical Equipment

### Mechanical Ventilators and Respiratory Support Systems

We manufacture a wide range of modern ventilators designed for intensive care, transport, and
emergency situations. Our devices support both invasive and non-invasive ventilation for adult,
pediatric, and neonatal patients.

#### ZisLine MV350 — Advanced ICU Ventilator

High-performance intensive care ventilator with advanced ventilation modes and excellent monitoring
capabilities.

#### ZisLine T100 — Portable Transport Ventilator

Compact and reliable transport ventilator ideal for ambulances, intra-hospital transport, and
emergency medical services.

### Patient Monitoring Systems

Treaton offers high-precision patient monitors and central monitoring stations that provide
real-time monitoring of vital signs in operating rooms and intensive care units.

### OEM Modules and Components

We develop and supply advanced OEM solutions for medical device manufacturers, including:

#### Mainstream and Sidestream Gas Analysis Modules

High-accuracy CO₂, O₂, and anesthetic gas monitoring sensors for integration into anesthesia
machines and ventilators.

#### Depth of Anesthesia and Sedation Monitoring Modules

Advanced Brain Activity Index (AI) monitoring technology for safe and effective procedural sedation
and general anesthesia.

## Why Medical Institutions Choose Treaton

### Proven Quality and International Certification

All Treaton equipment undergoes strict quality control and meets international standards. Our
products are certified and regularly tested in real clinical conditions.

### Innovation Backed by 35 Years of Experience

#### Advanced Technologies Developed In-House

Our key developments include indirect calorimetry for metabolic assessment and unique non-invasive
hemodynamic monitoring technologies.

#### Continuous Research and Development

We constantly improve our products by implementing the latest achievements in biomedical engineering
and respiratory support.

### Reliable Service and Technical Support

We provide full lifecycle support for our equipment:

#### Warranty and Post-Warranty Maintenance

#### Extended Warranty Programs

#### Professional Training for Biomedical Engineers

#### 24/7 Technical Consultation and Prompt Repair Service

### Professional Team Dedicated to Your Success

Our team consists of experienced engineers, developers, anesthesiologists, and international sales
specialists who work closely with each client to deliver the best technical and commercial
solutions.

## Customized OEM Solutions for Medical Device Manufacturers

Treaton is a reliable OEM partner offering high-precision gas analysis modules, sedation monitoring
systems, and other critical components. We help manufacturers enhance their equipment with
cutting-edge technology while reducing development time and costs.

## Partner with Treaton Today

Contact our team to learn more about our full range of medical ventilators, patient monitors, OEM
modules, and comprehensive service programs. We are ready to provide tailored solutions that
perfectly match the needs of your hospital, clinic, or manufacturing project.

**Treaton — Advanced Medical Technology • Reliable Performance • Professional Support • 35 Years of
Excellence**

capabilities.

#### ZisLine T100 — Portable Transport Ventilator

Compact and reliable transport ventilator ideal for ambulances, intra-hospital transport, and
emergency medical services.

### Patient Monitoring Systems

Treaton offers high-precision patient monitors and central monitoring stations that provide
real-time monitoring of vital signs in operating rooms and intensive care units.

### OEM Modules and Components

We develop and supply advanced OEM solutions for medical device manufacturers, including:

#### Mainstream and Sidestream Gas Analysis Modules

High-accuracy CO₂, O₂, and anesthetic gas monitoring sensors for integration into anesthesia
machines and ventilators.

#### Depth of Anesthesia and Sedation Monitoring Modules

Advanced Brain Activity Index (AI) monitoring technology for safe and effective procedural sedation
and general anesthesia.

## Why Medical Institutions Choose Treaton

### Proven Quality and International Certification

All Treaton equipment undergoes strict quality control and meets international standards. Our
products are certified and regularly tested in real clinical conditions.

### Innovation Backed by 35 Years of Experience

#### Advanced Technologies Developed In-House

Our key developments include indirect calorimetry for metabolic assessment and unique non-invasive
hemodynamic monitoring technologies.

#### Continuous Research and Development

We constantly improve our products by implementing the latest achievements in biomedical engineering
and respiratory support.

### Reliable Service and Technical Support

We provide full lifecycle support for our equipment:

#### Warranty and Post-Warranty Maintenance

#### Extended Warranty Programs

#### Professional Training for Biomedical Engineers

#### 24/7 Technical Consultation and Prompt Repair Service

### Professional Team Dedicated to Your Success

Our team consists of experienced engineers, developers, anesthesiologists, and international sales
specialists who work closely with each client to deliver the best technical and commercial
solutions.

## Customized OEM Solutions for Medical Device Manufacturers

Treaton is a reliable OEM partner offering high-precision gas analysis modules, sedation monitoring
systems, and other critical components. We help manufacturers enhance their equipment with
cutting-edge technology while reducing development time and costs.

## Partner with Treaton Today

Contact our team to learn more about our full range of medical ventilators, patient monitors, OEM
modules, and comprehensive service programs. We are ready to provide tailored solutions that
perfectly match the needs of your hospital, clinic, or manufacturing project.

stores, fight against budget restraints, and deal with complicated pickup or delivery requirements.
At Vitality Medical, we work hard to take the stress out of purchasing medical supplies, letting you
worry less about your purchase and more about the health of you or your loved one.
* ## Delivering Quality and Reliability
  
  Vitality Medical stands out as a leading online destination for discount medical supplies and
  equipment, offering over 100,000 products from reputable brands. Since 2000, over 2.5 million
  customers have trusted Vitality Medical for their healthcare needs, conveniently browsing and
  purchasing a wide range of medical supplies online. This has made Vitality Medical a go-to source
  for both consumers and resellers. Our commitment to quality and service is recognized by top
  ratings, including an [**A+ from the Better Business Bureau**][98] and a [**4.2-star rating on

  and read [**testimonials**][102] on [**Trustpilot**][103] and [**Reseller Ratings**][104].
* ## Committed to Affordable Medical Supplies
  
  At Vitality Medical, affordability and quality go hand in hand. Our product experts are dedicated
  to helping customers find medical supplies online that fits both their needs and their budgets.
  We’re committed to offering the best prices. **If you find a lower price elsewhere, we'll match
  it**. Our national network of warehouses, stocked with top-tier brands, guarantees fast and
  reliable shipping. Many of these warehouses are strategically located near major metropolitan
  areas, ensuring that your medical supplies arrive quickly and cost-effectively, right when you
  need them. Sign up for our newsletter to stay informed about exclusive sales and promotions. We
  regularly offer discounts on both innovative new products and everyday essentials.
* ## Why Choose Vitality Medical
  
  Navigating the world of home medical supplies can be overwhelming. Vitality Medical is here to
  guide you every step of the way. Our customer service team receives regular training to ensure
  they can answer all your product-related questions. If an item is out of stock, our team will go
  the extra mile to find it, underscoring our commitment to helping you **Add Vitality to Your
  Life**.
  
  For purchasing agents in hospitals, caregiver facilities, or retail, our [Business to
  Business][105] section offers tailored solutions and information to meet your specific needs.
  
  When you choose Vitality Medical as your online medical supply store, you’re choosing convenience,
  dependability, and expertise. Explore our products today to find the equipment you need. You can
  also [contact our team][106] to learn more about our products, get help navigating our
  collections, and make an informed, confident purchase.
